To keep the process running smoothly, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker: - You are 18 years or older - You speak Dutch or English - You are available 4 to 5 days per week - You are available for the morning shift from 07:10 to 14:55 - You are available on Saturdays and Mondays - You are physically able to lift boxes up to 20 kg if necessary - You are willing to work in Ridderkerk - You have your own transport or travel by public transport 
 what will you do 
As a production worker, you work in an energetic and multicultural team. Early in the morning, you start the shift with a quick handover. Together, you then ensure that all fresh products are checked and packed perfectly for the customers. If a VOG (Certificate of Conduct) or reference check is ever required for this role, we will handle that request safely later in the process.
